note: Quitman County has a zoning ordinance (adopted 2019) and the official zoning map is held by the zoning administrator; no county or city zoning district polygon layer is published as a queryable ArcGIS service. ArcGIS searches and the county, MARIS and state services turned up only parcels, flood and section layers, no zoning districts; the City of Marks and Lambert showed no zoning GIS either.
